Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key, or name, for the resource tag.

Value.description: The value for the resource tag.

schema.description: Resource Type definition for AWS::Redshift::Snapshot. Creates a manual snapshot of the specified cluster. The cluster must be in the available state.

AvailabilityZone.description: The Availability Zone in which the cluster was created.

ClusterCreateTime.description: The time (UTC) when the cluster was originally created.

ClusterIdentifier.description: The cluster identifier for which you want a snapshot.

ClusterVersion.description: The version ID of the Amazon Redshift engine that is running on the cluster.

DBName.description: The name of the database that was created when the cluster was created.

Encrypted.description: If true, the data in the snapshot is encrypted at rest.

EncryptedWithHSM.description: A boolean that indicates whether the snapshot data is encrypted using the HSM keys of the source cluster.

EngineFullVersion.description: The engine full version of the cluster at the time the snapshot was taken.

EnhancedVpcRouting.description: An option that specifies whether to create the cluster with enhanced VPC routing enabled.

KmsKeyId.description: The Key Management Service (KMS) key ID of the encryption key that was used to encrypt data in the cluster from which the snapshot was taken.

MaintenanceTrackName.description: The name of the maintenance track for the snapshot.

ManualSnapshotRetentionPeriod.description: The number of days that a manual snapshot is retained. If the value is -1, the manual snapshot is retained indefinitely. The value must be either -1 or an integer between 1 and 3653.

MasterUsername.description: The admin user name for the cluster.

NodeType.description: The node type that the cluster is provisioned with.

NumberOfNodes.description: The number of nodes in the cluster.

OwnerAccount.description: The Amazon Web Services account that owns the snapshot.

Port.description: The port that the cluster is listening on.

SnapshotArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the snapshot.

SnapshotCreateTime.description: The time (in UTC format) when Amazon Redshift began the snapshot.

SnapshotIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for the snapshot that you are requesting. This identifier must be unique for all snapshots within the Amazon Web Services account.

SnapshotType.description: The snapshot type. Snapshots created using CreateClusterSnapshot and CopyClusterSnapshot are of type manual.

Status.description: The snapshot status. The value of the status depends on the API operation used: CreateClusterSnapshot and CopyClusterSnapshot returns status as creating. DescribeClusterSnapshots returns status as creating, available, final snapshot, or failed. DeleteClusterSnapshot returns status as deleted.

VpcId.description: The VPC identifier of the cluster if the snapshot is from a cluster in a VPC.
